description:
[Trading Data API] US equity earnings announcement calendar: report date, before/after-market timing, analyst EPS estimate + count, market cap, and prior-year actual EPS — US equity earnings announcement calendar: report date, before/after-market timing, analyst EPS estimate + count, market cap, and prior-year actual EPS. Sourced live from Nasdaq's public calendar.

**Example:** `/v1/earnings-calendar?date=2026-07-14&days=3`

days.description: Optional. Days to scan forward from date (default 1, max 7).

symbol.description: Optional. Filter to one ticker within the scanned range.

name: earnings_calendar
